design_description: A bold electric-blue design energized by vivid pink wave graphics flowing across the lower torso and sleeve cuffs. The swirling pattern creates a strong sense of movement and rhythm, almost resembling flames, ocean currents, or smoke trails, giving the jersey a highly dynamic visual identity. The contrast between the saturated blue base and neon pink overlays makes the kit feel youthful, loud, and nightlife-inspired, while the clean upper chest keeps the composition balanced. Overall, the design blends football culture with festival and streetwear aesthetics, creating a vibrant and expressive look.
